subject: Exec intro: aligning VP/CIO attendance + recording preference for Aurorae demo
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@aurorae.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@aurorae.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + request for VP/CIO on demo (Aurorae)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick response after the webinar last week — Aurorae had a lot of interest in Redwood’s latency and cost controls. Tom (cc'd) is leading our infra evaluation. We want to set up a 45-minute demo next week that includes a short executive intro so our VP Product (Amira Patel) and CIO (Rajesh Menon) can see the platform fit.

Can your team accommodate a slot the week of Dec 13? Our preference would be an afternoon (ET) when both Amira and Rajesh are available. Also: are you able to avoid recording the session? We have a strict policy around recordings that include certain architecture details. If recording is unavoidable, we need it turned off or have a version that redacts infra notes.

Happy to share a mutual action plan if that helps accelerate scheduling.

Best,
Lena
Director of Infrastructure
Aurorae Systems

Attachments: aurorae-questions-quick.pdf (pdf, 78KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@aurorae.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@aurorae.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + request for VP/CIO on demo (Aurorae)

Hi Lena — thanks for reaching out and for the context. Happy to run a focused 45-minute demo and block an exec intro.

Quick answers up front:
- We can target the week of Dec 13; propose three windows in ET: Tue 12/14 3:00–3:45pm ET, Wed 12/15 1:30–2:15pm ET, or Thu 12/16 4:00–4:45pm ET. Let me know which works best for Amira and Rajesh.
- Recording: we can turn recording off for the session. For internal note-taking we typically capture non-sensitive highlights in our notes doc instead; we will refrain from platform-level recordings that capture infra-level logs or keys. Please confirm if that satisfies your policy.
- Agenda proposal (45 min): 1) 10-min executive intro + success metrics, 2) 25-min demo (hosting modes + cost/latency examples), 3) 10-min Q&A + next steps.

I’ve attached our demo deck and a draft mutual action plan so we can align on decision checkpoints. Grace (cc) will help coordinate slots and the invite. Karthik — pinging you for a quick availability check in case we want a backup CTO-level presence.

If any of the proposed times are tricky, tell me preferred ranges and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf, aurorae-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Lena Park <lena.park@aurorae.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@aurorae.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + request for VP/CIO on demo (Aurorae)

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the options and the flexibility on recording.

Confirmed: Wed 12/15 1:30–2:15pm ET works for Amira and Rajesh. Recording must be off — that is firm. We will send calendar invites from our side once you confirm the final attendee list and expected pre-reads.

One small ask: could the demo avoid showing raw audit logs or KMS screenshots? We can share a sanitized architecture slide in advance if helpful.

Tom will follow up with a short availability for a quick pre-demo sync (internal) the day before.

Best,
Lena

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@aurorae.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@aurorae.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request for VP/CIO on demo (Aurorae)

Perfect — Wed 12/15 1:30–2:15pm ET is locked.

Summary / next steps:
- Marcus (me) — run exec intro + demo; I’ll avoid any raw audit logs or KMS screenshots and will disable recording on the call.
- Grace — will send the calendar invite with dial-in and include the two attachments (deck + MAP) as pre-reads.
- Tom — thanks for offering the pre-demo sync; a 20-min internal touchpoint midday Tue 12/14 to align on questions would be great.

Grace — please propose the invite and mark the session as non-recordable in the meeting options.

Looking forward — Marcus
